flood.name: River flood
flood.lesson: Wetlands hold floodwater; levees can transfer risk downstream.
flood.mitigation: Preserve wetlands, restore forests, coordinate river defenses.

dam_failure.name: Dam-break flood
dam_failure.lesson: A dam is part of a larger hazard system: shaking can become a downstream flood.

hurricane.name: Hurricane & surge
hurricane.lesson: Storm surge is pushed ashore by storm winds. Coastal ecosystems reduce wave energy.
hurricane.mitigation: Mangroves, shelters, resilient grids and coordinated barriers.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.lesson: Earthquakes are tectonic, not caused by warming. Fault exposure and building design matter.
earthquake.mitigation: Seismic engineering, repair and avoid fragile dams on faults.

tsunami.name: Tsunami
tsunami.lesson: Sudden displacement of seawater can produce waves across an ocean. It is distinct from storm surge.
tsunami.mitigation: Early warning, elevated shelters and evacuation routes.

volcano.name: Volcanic eruption
volcano.lesson: Ash travels downwind, damaging machinery, air quality and water supplies far from the vent.
volcano.mitigation: Forecasting, shelters, water reserves and diversified power.

drought.name: Drought
drought.lesson: Water scarcity links agriculture, energy and trade. Shared aquifers make over-pumping everyone’s problem.
drought.mitigation: Drip irrigation, reserves and climate-ready crops.

heatwave.name: Heat dome
heatwave.lesson: Urban surfaces retain heat. Cooling demand can overwhelm electricity grids.
heatwave.mitigation: Trees, reflective surfaces, water access and microgrids.

wildfire.name: Wildfire & smoke
wildfire.lesson: Fire damages landscapes while smoke affects communities downwind.
wildfire.mitigation: Land stewardship, resilient shelters and warning networks.

spill.name: Oil spill
spill.lesson: Ocean currents transport oil beyond the producer’s coast; fisheries and tourism bear the cost.
spill.mitigation: Transition away from rigs, blue restoration and mutual aid.

smog.name: Smog & acid deposition
smog.lesson: Air pollution crosses borders. Sulfur and nitrogen emissions contribute to acid deposition.
smog.mitigation: Clean energy, forests and emissions controls.

sea_rise.name: Coastal inundation
sea_rise.lesson: Warming seas expand and land ice melts. Saltwater intrusion threatens freshwater supplies.
sea_rise.mitigation: Cut emissions, preserve coastal buffers and adapt infrastructure.

landslide.name: Landslide
landslide.lesson: Slope failure can block transport and add sediment to downstream rivers.
landslide.mitigation: Forest protection, slope planning and warning networks.

grid_failure.name: Grid cascade
grid_failure.lesson: Interdependent infrastructure spreads outages into food, water and economic systems.
grid_failure.mitigation: Storage, distributed generation and energy reserves.

pandemic.name: Public-health shock
pandemic.lesson: Prepared health systems and cooperation limit disruption to communities and livelihoods.
pandemic.mitigation: Resilience hubs, reserves, mutual aid and research.

supply_shock.name: Supply-chain shock
supply_shock.lesson: Dependence on a narrow set of suppliers turns distant disruption into local shortages.
supply_shock.mitigation: Diversify trade, keep reserves and maintain open shipping.
